item.description: U.S. Northern Command’s JTF Gold has been assigned a new mission defending Golden Dome systems against cyberattacks, its deputy says. The task force is in early stages, coordinating agencies & vendors, and trying to lock down what responsibilities such a mission actually entails.
item.content:encoded:
@faytuksnetwork

U.S. Northern Command’s JTF Gold has been assigned a new mission defending Golden Dome systems against cyberattacks, its deputy says. The task force is in early stages, coordinating agencies & vendors, and trying to lock down what responsibilities such a mission actually entails.

item.description: A U.S. military official says American forces destroyed a dhow used by Iranian spotters to identify ships, including U.S. warships, for IRGC targeting last week. Crew members were ordered off before the strike. The image is just a random dhow, for context.
item.content:encoded:
@faytuksnetwork

A U.S. military official says American forces destroyed a dhow used by Iranian spotters to identify ships, including U.S. warships, for IRGC targeting last week. Crew members were ordered off before the strike. The image is just a random dhow, for context.

item.title: @faytuksnetwork: A U.S. Navy F-35C from VX-23 completed the first arrested landing and catapult launch aboard a Ford class carrier yester
item.description: A U.S. Navy F-35C from VX-23 completed the first arrested landing and catapult launch aboard a Ford class carrier yesterday, operating from the future USS John F. Kennedy (CVN-79). Big milestone for the class. And the airframe.
item.content:encoded:
@faytuksnetwork

A U.S. Navy F-35C from VX-23 completed the first arrested landing and catapult launch aboard a Ford class carrier yesterday, operating from the future USS John F. Kennedy (CVN-79). Big milestone for the class. And the airframe.
